#### ...a Process, not a Place

### Key Dates and Events

- November 5, 2024—Election Day The voters in each State choose electors to serve in the Electoral College.
- By December 11, 2024—Electors Appointed The State Executive of each State signs the Certificate of Ascertainment to appoint the electors chosen in the general election.
- December 17, 2024—Electors vote The electors in each State meet to select the President and Vice President of the United States.
- January 6, 2025—Congress counts the vote Congress meets in joint session to count the electoral votes (unless Congress passes a law to change the date from a Saturday or Sunday).
- January 20, 2025—Inauguration Day The President-Elect is sworn in as President of the United States.
